case.summary: Case HHG-007 was opened after transaction 3514948 on card C09933-K2 triggered a bank risk score of 0.87. Graph analysis confirmed an account takeover pattern with a fraud probability of 0.98 and a total exposure of $265.85 across 3 affected transactions (3508487, 3514573, 3514948). The closed-case classifier scored the flagged transaction at 0.96, and historical context reveals numerous prior confirmed fraud cases for customer C09933. Consequently, the recommended actions are to block the card via L1 and create a fraud case automatically under §3a.
